{{Top|leg}}
'''Plastiboard''' was a construction material used as a flooring material. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]] used plastiboard to cover a shaft connecting a catwalk to the [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] below. When broken, plastiboard splintered into shards.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
